Hmm this is getting complicated. Wait — for stair-flight-1, the child placement has axis [1,0,0] and ref_direction [0,1,0]. Good — this is coherent for flight-1.

The contract says: "For an axis-aligned flight with neutral child placement and width extrusion [1,0,0], a +Y run starts at (x_min,y_min)...". Here the width extrusion is [0,0,1] in child frame which is world X. Hmm, contract section says "The horizontal Representation.direction is the width vector." direction [0,0,1] in child frame = world X = width. So the profile plane is world Y-Z. Flight-1 profile run +Y: from the start, run increases north. Flight-1 is south_to_north starting at south end.
